<div class="homepage-news" id="cphContent_divNewsSection">
<div class="wrapper">
<div class="homepage-newsArticles">
<div class="homepage-newsArticles-graphic">
<img alt="News section" src="/images/graphics/NewsIcon.png"/>
</div>
<div class="homepage-newsArticles-articles">
<h2 class="homepage-newsArticles-title">News &amp; Announcements</h2>
<ul class="undecorated">
<li class="homepage-newsArticles-article">
<h3 style="color: #AE1212">Disaster Assistance</h3>
<p>If you have been impacted by a natural disaster, you may be able to postpone your payments. 
           <a href="/DL/resourceCenter/DisasterAssistance.aspx">Learn more<span class="readerText"> about repayment options</span></a>.</p>
</li>
<li class="homepage-newsArticles-article">
<h3 style="color: #AE1212">Temporary Expanded Public Service Loan Forgiveness </h3>
<p>
</p><p style="margin: 0in 0in 8pt;"><span lang="EN" style="mso-ansi-language: EN;"><font face="Calibri"></font></span></p><p style="margin: 0in 0in 8pt;"></p><p style="margin: 0in 0in 8pt;"><font face="Calibri"><font face="Times New Roman">
</font><font face="Times New Roman"><span lang="EN" style="mso-ansi-language: EN;">If your PSLF
application was denied because some or all of your payments were not made on a
qualifying repayment plan for PSLF, you may be able to receive loan forgiveness
under a temporary opportunity.</span></font></font></p><p style="margin: 0in 0in 8pt;"><font face="Calibri"><font face="Times New Roman">

For more information, please visit:<font face="Times New Roman"><a href="https://studentaid.ed.gov/sa/repay-loans/forgiveness-cancellation/public-service/temporary-expanded-public-service-loan-forgiveness" target="_blank"><font face="Calibri">https://studentaid.ed.gov/sa/repay-loans/forgiveness-cancellation/public-service/temporary-expanded-public-service-loan-forgiveness</font></a></font></font></font></p><p style="margin: 0in 0in 8pt;"></p><p style="margin: 0in 0in 8pt;"></p><p style="margin: 0in 0in 8pt;"></p><p></p><p style="margin: 0in 0in 8pt;"></p><p style="margin: 0in 0in 8pt;"></p><p>
</p>
</li>
<li class="homepage-newsArticles-article">
<h3 style="color: initial">Mobile App</h3>
<p>Visit your App Store to download the MOHELA 
              <a href="https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mohela.MOHELA" target="_blank">Android</a> or 
              <a href="https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/mohela/id1082597420" target="_blank">iOS</a> Apps, where you can  
              view account details and make 
           payments to specific loans.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="TimelyArticles" id="cphContent_divTimelyArticles">
<div class="wrapper">
<div class="TimelyArticles-articles">
<a class="TimelyArticles-article" href="/DL/resourceCenter/Repayment.aspx" onclick="" target="_self">
<div class="TimelyArticles-articleHeader" style="background-image: url('/images/graphics/defermentForbearance.png');">
<div class="TimelyArticles-articleTitle">
<h2>Trouble Paying?</h2>
</div>
</div>
<span class="TimelyArticles-articleBody">
                        
          We want to help. Call us for a customized solution to lower or postpone your payments. You may qualify for a repayment plan with monthly payments as low as $0. 
		   
                     </span>
</a>
<a class="TimelyArticles-article" href="/DL/resourceCenter/MilitaryBenefits.aspx" onclick="" target="_self">
<div class="TimelyArticles-articleHeader" style="background-image: url('/images/graphics/military.png');">
<div class="TimelyArticles-articleTitle">
<h2>Military</h2>
</div>
</div>
<span class="TimelyArticles-articleBody">
                        
          If you have served or currently serve our country, you may qualify for student loan benefits and assistance.
		   
                     </span>
</a>
<a class="TimelyArticles-article" href="/DL/resourceCenter/AvoidCostlyMistakes.aspx" onclick="" target="_self">
<div class="TimelyArticles-articleHeader" style="background-image: url('/images/graphics/scamAlert.png');">
<div class="TimelyArticles-articleTitle">
<h2>Avoid Fraud &amp; Scams</h2>
</div>
</div>
<span class="TimelyArticles-articleBody">
                        
          You never have to pay for student loan help.
		   
                     </span>
</a>
</div>

<div class="PrimaryArticles sectionBlue" id="cphContent_divPrimaryArticles">
<div class="wrapper">
<div class="PrimaryArticles-section">
<div>
<h2>
<span id="cphContent_primaryArticleTitle">Repayment Options, Loan Forgiveness &amp; Loan Discharge</span>
</h2>
</div>
<div class="PrimaryArticles-articles">
<div class="PrimaryArticles-article">
<h3>
          Federal Direct Loans<br/><br/>
</h3>
<p>
<a href="/DL/resourceCenter/RepaymentPlans.aspx"><strong>Repayment Plans</strong></a> - A variety of repayment plans are available to meet your needs, including plans based 
                  on your income and family size.
              </p>
<p>
<a href="/DL/resourceCenter/RepaymentOptions.aspx"><strong>Deferment &amp; Forbearance</strong></a> - Once in repayment, there may be times when you are unable to make your monthly 
                    payment. You may be eligible to postpone your payments.
              </p>
<p>
<a href="/DL/resourceCenter/LoanForgivenessDischarge.aspx"><strong>Forgiveness &amp; Discharge</strong></a> - In certain situations, you may qualify to have your student loan forgiven or 
                  discharged, meaning that you will no longer be required to repay some or all of your loan.
              </p>
<hr/>
<p>
<a href="https://studentloans.gov/myDirectLoan/repayOptions.action" target="_blank"><strong>Pick a Student Loan Repayment Option<span class="readerText"> external link</span></strong></a>
</p>
<p>
<a href="https://studentaid.ed.gov/sa/repay-loans" target="_blank"><strong>How to Repay Your Loans<span class="readerText"> external link</span></strong></a>
</p>
</div>
<div class="divider"></div>
<div class="PrimaryArticles-article">
<h3>
          Family Education Loan Program (FFELP)
        </h3>
<p>
<a href="/DL/resourceCenter/RepaymentPlans.aspx"><strong>Repayment Plans</strong></a> - A variety of repayment plans are available to meet your needs, including Income-Based 
                  Repayment, which is based on your income and family size.
              </p>
<p>
<a href="/DL/resourceCenter/RepaymentOptions.aspx"><strong>Deferment &amp; Forbearance</strong></a> - Once in repayment, there may be times when you are unable to make your monthly 
                    payment. You may be eligible to postpone your payments.
              </p>
<p>
<a href="/DL/resourceCenter/LoanForgivenessDischarge.aspx"><strong>Forgiveness &amp; Discharge</strong></a> - In certain situations, you may qualify to have your student loan forgiven or 
                  discharged, meaning that you will no longer be required to repay some or all of your loan.
              </p>
<hr/>
<p>
<a href="https://studentloans.gov/myDirectLoan/repayOptions.action" target="_blank"><strong>Pick a Student Loan Repayment Option<span class="readerText"> external link</span></strong></a>
</p>
<p>
<a href="https://studentaid.ed.gov/sa/repay-loans" target="_blank"><strong>How to Repay Your Loans<span class="readerText"> external link</span></strong></a>
</p>
</div>
<div class="divider"></div>
<div class="PrimaryArticles-article">
<h3>
          CASHLoans<br/>(Owned by MOHELA)  
        </h3>
<p>
<a href="/DL/resourceCenter/CashLoans/CashLoanModification.aspx"><strong>Loan Modification</strong></a> - If you are experiencing hardship making your monthly payment, you may be eligible 
                for a CASHLoan Modification.
            </p>
<p>
<a href="/DL/resourceCenter/CashLoans/OptionsToPostponeRepayment.aspx"><strong>Deferment &amp; Forbearance</strong></a> - Once in repayment, there may be times when you are unable to make your monthly 
                  payment. You may be eligible to postpone your payments.
            </p>
<p>
<a href="/DL/resourceCenter/CashLoans/LoanForgivenessOptions.aspx"><strong>Forgiveness &amp; Discharge</strong></a> - In certain situations, you may qualify to have your student loan discharged, 
                meaning that you will no longer be required to repay some or all of your loan.
            </p>
<hr/>
<p>
<a href="/DL/resourceCenter/CashLoans/HelpCenter.aspx"><strong>CASHLoan Info Center</strong></a>
</p>
</div>
<div class=""></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<h3>Help &amp; Support</h3>
